subject: Northport AZ1 sudden throughput collapse — containment and exec update
messages:
From: Elena Cruz <elena.cruz@northport.com>
To: sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
Cc: infra@northport.com
Date: Sat, 10 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: API errors — massive 5xx spike and user impact

Sean,

We're seeing a hard drop in throughput from our production AZ1 starting ~08:50 PDT. API error rate jumped to ~28% 5xx, request latency spiked to 4-6s, and customers are reporting timeouts. Our frontend started diverting to the backup region, but it looks like the traffic shift caused backend cache missstorms and amplified failures. We've attached the error export and a short SLO snapshot.

We need immediate assistance: can Redwood confirm whether an automated cross-region redirect is available for our account, and advise steps to mitigate customer impact? We're on a tight maintenance window for the afternoon but this is higher priority.

Elena
Head of Platform, Northport Logistics

Attachments: northport-error-log-az1.csv, slo-uptime-snapshot.png

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Cruz <elena.cruz@northport.com>
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 10 Oct 2026 09:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RE: API errors — massive 5xx spike and user impact

Elena, thanks for the quick context and the logs — I can see the 5xx burst in the file. Looping in Ops (Hannah) and SE (Marcus) to get a containment plan in flight. Vanessa I'll need your read on account tolerances and whether we can authorize a priority pin / temporary routing change.

Immediate ask:
- Hannah: can the SREs open an emergency bridge and validate whether we can drain AZ1 and redirect ingress to us-west2/us-east2? Please call out cold-start penalty estimates.
- Marcus: prepare customer-facing copy for a 1-line status and an FAQ for expected latency.
- Vanessa: advise on credits/contractary things we should pre-approve so account team can move fast.

I'd like an exec sync at 15:00 PDT to brief Northport and Redwood execs on actions and approvals. If we need to move faster let's escalate.

Sean
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference

Note: attaching ops-drain-runbook.md to help Ops (referenced below).

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: sean.gallagher@redwood.ai, elena.cruz@northport.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 10 Oct 2026 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RE: API errors — massive 5xx spike and user impact

Short technical summary from SRE triage:
- Observed: AZ1 serving group for Northport saturated on both GRPC workers and KV cache. KV cache eviction rate spiked by 12x after the frontend shift, leading to repeated recompute for hot prefixes.
- 5xx type: predominantly resource exhaustion (507/521) with small percentage of 502 from upstream timeouts.
- Recommended immediate actions (containment):
  1) Open SRE bridge (I've started INC-4829).
  2) Enable cross-region ingress steer to us-west2 with session affinity disabled for 30 minutes to relieve AZ1.
  3) Activate circuit breaker on the most expensive routes to stop backpressure into origin (we'll return 429 quickly instead of cascading 5xx).
  4) Start a controlled drain of AZ1; note there will be cold-start latency for warmed instances in target region (~200-400ms p95 additional).

I can have the bridge up in 5 minutes and run the steer within 12 minutes after approvals. Attaching runbook snippets and the quick-drain script.

Hannah
Senior SRE — Redwood Inference

Quoted: "On Sat, 10 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700 Elena Cruz wrote: We're seeing a hard drop in throughput from our production AZ1..."

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: sean.gallagher@redwood.ai, elena.cruz@northport.com
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 10 Oct 2026 10:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RE: API errors — massive 5xx spike and user impact

I'll own the customer comms once we confirm the failover path. Suggested public note:
- One-line: We're experiencing degraded service in Northport AZ1; traffic is being redirected to a healthy region while our engineers investigate. Expect intermittent latency for the next 30-60 minutes.
- FAQ bullets: impact window, what we're doing, what customers can do (retry with jitter), when we'll update.

Also recommend we offer Northport a one-time usage credit for the impacted hour and proactively extend longer rate-limits on their priority pin while traffic is shifted. Vanessa — please confirm if that credit falls within your delegation or we need AR approval.

Operational asks:
- Confirm SRE bridge URL and bridge lead.
- Confirm whether to apply automated routing config or manual ingress adjustment.

I'll stand by to push the status note to Northport's status page and coordinate social comms.

Marcus
Principal Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: elena.cruz@northport.com
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 10 Oct 2026 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RE: API errors — massive 5xx spike and user impact — Exec update

Elena, team — brief update and summary for execs:
- Action taken: SRE bridge opened (INC-4829); controlled drain of AZ1 executed and cross-region ingress steer applied to us-west2 at ~10:05 PDT. Circuit breakers enabled on three heavy routes.
- Impact: error rate fell from 28% to 2.3% within 18 minutes of steering; p95 latency improved but we observed a +250ms cold-start delta on certain heavy payloads. Throughput stabilized at ~85% of baseline after warm-up.
- Customer comms: Marcus published the short status note to Northport's status page and we pushed a message to their support queue.
- Compensation: Vanessa approved a discretionary credit of one hour at baseline rate and a temporary priority pin while we complete postmortem.

Next steps:
1) SRE to run deeper root-cause analysis and share KVC statistics and kernel-level logs by EOD.
2) Product to evaluate longer term fixes (distributed prefix warming, reactive cache prefetch).
3) Prepare an exec-facing one-page for Northport C-suite by 10/11 12:00 PDT — Vanessa/Sean to co-author.

If Northport wants an immediate bridge between our VPs, we can schedule a 30-minute exec sync. Thanks to everyone for the rapid response.

Sean Gallagher
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference

Attachments: ops-drain-runbook.md (applied), northport-error-log-az1.csv (from customer)
